verdict.rationale: An email product could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. The pack documents no user-facing Zero CLI. The `pnpm go`, `pnpm nizzy env`, `pnpm db:studio` and `pnpm eval` commands are contributor and dev-environment scripts for running the repo, not a CLI for using the product. The MCP server belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
